_description: Per-file baselines for the mechanical invariants in scripts/guard-invariants.mjs. A file may hold FEWER occurrences than recorded here; it may never hold more; a file absent from a rule may hold none. Counts only ratchet DOWN — `node scripts/guard-invariants.mjs --update` lowers them to match the tree and refuses to raise any, so blessing an addition needs a hand edit that lands in a reviewable diff. Rules 1, 7 and 10 appear nowhere here: they are at zero and enforced absolutely.
